items.body: Utah requires generative AI to disclose it is not a person, enforced by the Division of Consumer Protection with fines to $2,500 per violation. Amended in 2025 to narrow the general duty to high-risk interactions, with a stricter always-on rule for regulated occupations.
items.headline: Utah AI Policy Act

items.body: Every state has an unfair-or-deceptive-practices statute that already reaches AI. Attorneys general are using them against overstated capability claims, chatbots posing as licensed professionals, undisclosed synthetic media, and foreseeable harm to users. No new law is required and none is being waited for.
items.headline: State AG Enforcement Under UDAP
